why: LANDED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 R8): renamed to `RmwParameterConversionError`, rclrs's name; the old name survives one release as a `#[deprecated]` type alias, and every in-tree caller moved. PRIOR ROW: Our spelling of rclrs's `RmwParameterConversionError`, exported from the `nros` facade since phase-417 W4.a. -- see `rust:RmwParameterConversionError` for the naming half. `reason()` is the sentence the `~/set_parameters` handler puts into the `SetParametersResult`, so a local caller and a remote one read the same words.
